audit.whatIsWrong: Four content fields say Galio's PASSIVE is a magic shield that absorbs your poke, and spikes[0] names a 'Shield Bash' combo. Neither exists.
audit.why: Colossal Smash (P) is an auto-attack reset that deals bonus magic damage in an area — no shield at all. Galio's shield comes from Shield of Durand (W), which taunts on release, and from Hero's Entrance (R), which shields allies in the landing zone. 'Shield Bash' is a fabricated ability name.
audit.corrected: whys[0], spikes[0].text, early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] rewritten around Winds of War, Colossal Smash and Shield of Durand.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer said 'Skill' at rows 4, 5 and 6 while content and the packet chart give Galio rows 4-5 and Kassadin row 6.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is a 180s map-wide ultimate that outweighs a level 6 Riftwalk, and Galio's MR scaling keeps him ahead through Kassadin's first item. Only at three items does the burst break through.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and phases[5].side set to Galio with matching whys; phases[6].side set to Kassadin.

audit.why: Spikes correctly place his level 6 as the map-pressure spike and Kassadin's flip at full build.

Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and knocks up the first champion it hits, which is what denies Riftwalk; Shield of Durand is 18/17/16/15/14s and taunts on release; Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s at 4000-5500 range.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with real numbers.
